Treatment Comparisons

Compare Dental Implant Treatments

Choosing between treatments can feel overwhelming. Our side-by-side comparison guides explain the key clinical differences in plain language — so you can make an informed decision with confidence.

Objective, Evidence-Based Comparisons

Each comparison guide below provides an honest, side-by-side analysis of two dental treatments. We cover what each treatment involves, the key clinical differences, potential advantages and considerations, cost factors, and guidance on suitability — all written in accordance with CQC, GDC, and ASA standards.

These guides are provided for educational purposes. The most appropriate treatment can only be determined following a clinical examination by a qualified dental professional.

All-on-4 vs All-on-6 Dental Implants

Two full-arch implant solutions — one uses four implants per arch, the other uses six. Compare the clinical differences, stability, bone requirements, and costs.

Full ArchFixed Teeth

All-on-4 vs Traditional Dental Implants

Compare the All-on-4 protocol with conventional individual implant placement. Understand the differences in treatment time, number of implants, and suitability.

Full ArchIndividual Implants

Dental Implants vs Bridges

A fixed implant versus a fixed bridge — both replace missing teeth but differ in how they are supported. Compare the impact on adjacent teeth, longevity, and cost.

Single ToothMultiple Teeth

Dental Implants vs Crowns

One replaces a missing tooth, the other restores a damaged one. Understand this commonly confused distinction and when each treatment is appropriate.

Single ToothRestorative

Dental Implants vs Dentures

Fixed versus removable tooth replacement — compare stability, comfort, bone preservation, maintenance, and long-term cost between implants and dentures.

Full ArchRemovable vs Fixed

Dental Implants vs Partial Dentures

For patients missing several teeth — compare fixed implant solutions with removable partial dentures. Understand the impact on remaining teeth and daily comfort.

Multiple TeethRemovable vs Fixed

Implant-Supported Dentures vs Regular Dentures

Both replace a full arch of teeth, but one is anchored by implants for improved stability. Compare retention, comfort, bone preservation, and cost.

DenturesStability

Mini Implants vs Standard Implants

Two types of dental implant — different in size, strength, and application. Compare bone requirements, load-bearing capacity, and suitability.

Implant TypesBone Considerations

Same-Day Implants vs Traditional Implants

One protocol provides provisional teeth on the day of surgery, the other follows a staged healing approach. Compare timelines, stability, and patient selection criteria.

Treatment ProtocolsTimeline

What Each Guide Covers

Every comparison follows a consistent, structured format — designed to give you a thorough understanding of each treatment option.

Key Clinical Differences

Advantages and Considerations

UK Cost Comparison

General cost factors and considerations for both treatments. Personalised quotations are provided following consultation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the most common patient questions, written in compliance with regulatory advertising standards.

Why Trust Our Comparison Guides

Our guides are written by dental professionals and reviewed for accuracy and regulatory compliance. We believe in giving you the information you need to make an informed choice — without exaggeration or pressure.

Regulatory Compliance

All content adheres to the standards set by the Care Quality Commission (CQC), General Dental Council (GDC), and Advertising Standards Authority (ASA).

Balanced & Objective

Every guide presents both treatments fairly — including potential advantages and considerations for each. We never favour one option over another without clinical justification.

No Pressure — Just Information

Our guides are designed to educate. The most suitable treatment can only be determined following a consultation with a qualified clinician at our South Kensington clinic.
